import dataclasses,hashlib,json,pathlib,sys
from ken.parsers.python import parse_python_file
import ken.parsers.python
request=json.load(sys.stdin)
assert pathlib.Path(ken.parsers.python.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(pathlib.Path(request['root']).resolve())
rows=[]
for case in request['inputs']:
 source=bytes.fromhex(case['source_hex']);result=parse_python_file(source,case['hint'])
 identity=hashlib.sha256(case['language'].encode()+b'\0'+case['hint'].encode()+b'\0'+source).hexdigest()
 rows.append(dict(id=identity,input=case,parsed=dataclasses.asdict(result)))
print(json.dumps(dict(cases=rows)))
